_rule: Each cell's C-Score limit factor, measured on IAM-Atlas v2.1's own healthy donors only (the cell found at 85 % or more): the one-sided 95 % prediction limit of C over the derived limit (cscore_limit), for one new reading. Only cells whose donors span five or more laboratories; every other cell keeps the derived limit (flagged). Built from atlas_donor_readings / the donors' bundles (DEV_METAA_HEALTHY_01).
